Anchor.description: Identifies which feature output contains the target entity.

oneOf.description: References an output of a specific feature in the tree.
References a datum (construction plane, axis, or point).

ArcSegment.description: An arc segment within a polygon profile, used to assign cylindrical face geometry on extrude.

center_u.description: Arc center in sketch UV coordinates.

end_vertex_index.description: Index into vertex_ids where the arc's sampled points end (inclusive).

start_vertex_index.description: Index into vertex_ids where the arc's sampled points begin.

placements.description: Solved placements by instance id — derived hints (see module doc).

AxialAnchor.description:
Where along a rotational face's axis a derived connector sits
(`crate::connector`, `specs/assembly_connector_adjustments.md`): the
middle of the face's axial extent (the default — what a Revolute or
Cylindrical mate wants) or one of its ends. The ends are named by the
connector's FINAL z (after `flip_z`), so they always read against the
triad the viewport draws: "+z end" is wherever the blue arrow points.
Ignored by every other pick (a planar face, a sphere, an edge, an
explicit frame).

oneOf.description: The end of the face's extent that z points toward.
The end of the face's extent that z points away from.

BooleanParams.description: Parameters for a boolean combine operation.

CircleProfile.description: Circle profile data in sketch-local UV coordinates.

ClosedProfile.description: A closed loop of sketch entities suitable for extrusion or revolution.

arc_segments.description: Arc segments within the polygon, used to assign cylindrical face geometry on extrude.

circle.description:
If this profile is a standalone circle, its center and radius in sketch UV coordinates.
When present, the kernel constructs a true NURBS circular wire instead of a polygon.

entity_ids.description: Ordered entity IDs forming the closed loop.

is_outer.description: Whether the profile winds counter-clockwise (outward) or clockwise (hole).

spline_segments.description: Segments that should be built as B-spline curves instead of lines.

vertex_ids.description:
Ordered point IDs in geometric winding order for polygon construction.
When non-empty, the kernel uses these instead of entity_ids or sorted keys.

CombineMode.description:
User-facing boolean-combine verb for a body-producing feature (extrude,
revolve, …). Maps to `modeling_ops::BooleanKind`: `Add→Union`,
`Cut→Subtract`, `Intersect→Intersect`; `NewBody` performs no boolean.

oneOf.description: Emit a separate, independent body; no boolean.
Union the tool into each target body.
Subtract the tool from each target body.
Intersect the tool with each target body.
Use the `depth` field directly.
Project target body vertices onto extrude direction, use max extent + margin.
Extrude up to a reference (face centroid, vertex, or datum plane).

DesignParameter.description:
A named design variable (parameter) on the feature tree.

`expression` is evaluated in mm-space (see `crate::expr`): bare numeric
literals mean millimeters in length contexts / degrees in angle contexts;
unit suffixes (`in`, `cm`, ...) scale literals; other parameters may be
referenced by name in any order (cycles are a loud per-parameter error).

error.description: Evaluation error from the last rebuild (`None` = evaluated cleanly).

name.description: Identifier used in expressions: `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, not reserved.

value.description:
Cached last-good evaluated value (mm-space), refreshed each rebuild.
Kept on evaluation failure so dependents hold their last geometry.

id.description:
Stable identity of the document (v4 §2.1): survives rename, provider
move and fork. Writers always emit it; a reader that finds it absent
mints one (this serde default) and the loader warns.

Embed.description:
Cached content bytes. Encoding tag + decoder shared with the v3 STEP
payload (`step_import::STEP_BLOB_ENCODING`, inflation-capped).

combine.description:
Explicit boolean-combine mode for this extrude. `None` ⇒ legacy file:
the effective mode is derived from `cut`/`merge` (see
`normalize_extrude_combine`). New features always write `Some(..)`.
See `specs/optional_booleans_multibody_extrude.md`.

depth_expr.description:
Optional driving expression for `depth` (mm-space -> meters). When
present, rebuild re-evaluates it against the design parameters and
writes the result into `depth`; `depth` always holds the last
evaluated value so old readers and the kernel see a plain number.

merge.description: Auto-union with existing body. Defaults to true for boss extrudes.

profile_entity_ids.description:
v4 §2.9 agent-friendly profile addressing. When present, the profile
is the solved loop whose entity-id set equals this set
(order-insensitive) and `profile_index` is ignored, so a writer that
has not run the solver can say "the loop bounded by entities 3,4,5,6"
(the same identity `Region::profile_entity_ids` carries). No such
loop, or two loops with the same set, is a loud per-feature error
(`EngineError::ProfileNotFound` / `ProfileAmbiguous`). The app's own
writers address by index and leave this `None`.

region.description:
Explicit region boundary for a sketch sub-region (annulus, lens, …) that
no whole-loop `profile_index` denotes. When `Some`, the face is built
directly from this boundary and `profile_index` is ignored. Whole-loop
selections leave this `None` and use `profile_index` (analytical path).

regions.description:
Multiple selected sub-regions extruded as ONE body. When ≥2, their 2D
footprints are unioned in the sketch plane into merged faces BEFORE the
extrude, so adjacent regions with shared/coplanar side walls merge
cleanly without a 3D boolean (which would hit the Yang Stage-0 coplanar
wall). Empty for single-region (`region`) / whole-profile (`profile_index`)
extrudes.

targets.description:
Explicit target bodies for the combine. `None` ⇒ Auto (bodies that share
a face with the sketch geometry). `Some(vec![])` ⇒ forced new body / no
targets. `Some([..])` ⇒ exactly those bodies. Only meaningful when
`combine` is `Some(Add|Cut|Intersect)`.

Feature.description: A single feature in the parametric feature tree.

operation.description: The modeling operation this feature performs.

references.description: GeomRefs to geometry that this feature depends on.

FeatureTree.description: The ordered list of modeling features.

active_index.description:
Features after this index are suppressed during rebuild.
None means all features are active.

body_names.description: User-assigned body names, independent of feature names.

features.description: Ordered list of features. Index 0 is the first feature.

parameters.description:
Named design variables. Order is display order only; expressions may
reference any parameter regardless of position.

provenance.description:
Feature provenance (v4 §2.7): who/what created each feature. Keyed by
feature id; GC'd on feature delete (captured for undo) like
`body_names`. Absent ⇒ `User`.

oneOf.description: Entity's surface/curve type must match.
Entity's normal must be within `tolerance` radians of `direction`.
Entity must be within `distance` of `point`.
Entity's area must be in range [min, max].

Frame.description:
A coordinate frame on part geometry: origin, primary (z) axis and
secondary (x) axis, in the PART's coordinates. `x_axis` is orthogonalized
against `z_axis`; a zero `x_axis` means "any perpendicular" (chosen
deterministically).

GearParams.description: Parameters for generating an involute gear profile.

internal.description:
Internal (ring) gear: teeth point INWARD. The profile is the toothed
inner boundary (a hole), to be combined with a user-drawn outer rim.
Standard offsets: tip (inner) at `pitch − module`, body/root (outer) at
`pitch + 1.25·module`; tooth = the conjugate of a meshing external gear's
space (`half_tooth_angle = angular_pitch/4 − inv α`).

GeomRef.description:
Persistent geometry reference. The core of the persistent naming system.
A GeomRef identifies a specific topological entity across parametric rebuilds.

anchor.description: Which feature's output contains this entity.

kind.description: What kind of topological entity this references.

policy.description: What to do when resolution is ambiguous or fails.

scope.description:
Where the anchor lives when it is NOT in the current tab (v4 §2.8,
in-context editing): the assembly whose instance owns the geometry
and the chain of instance ids down to it. Absent ⇒ local (the current
tab). A reader that does not know this field would silently resolve
the anchor locally, so its arrival bumped the reader floor (format v5).

selector.description: How to find the specific entity within the anchor's output.

GitHost.description:
Which API adapter resolves a `Git` locator (§7.2). Absent ⇒ inferred from
the remote's hostname, else `Generic`.

GitRef.description: A git ref: pinned to a commit, or floating on a branch/tag tip.

oneOf.description: Reproducible forever; "update" is a no-op.
Floating; `SourceEntry::resolved` records the tip at last sync.
Floating (tags can move); UIs may label it "release".

ImportedBodyParams.description:
Parameters for an imported (STEP) body feature — task #138,
`docs/step_import_roadmap.md` §3.3; v4 `specs/waffle_v4_document_model.md`
§2.11. Since v4 the STEP content lives in the document's `sources` table
and reaches the engine through its [`crate::sources::SourceStore`]; the
feature names its source by `source_id`. The v3 in-feature payload
(`blob_encoding` + `blob`) is still accepted as a legacy read path and is
what the single-tree API inlines for consumers that have no store. The
import replays on every rebuild (a process-wide parse cache makes
transform edits cheap).

Content resolution order at rebuild: the source store (embed or
host-provided), then the legacy inline blob; neither ⇒ a loud
`SourceUnavailable` feature error.

blob.description:
Legacy (v3) inline STEP text, encoded per `blob_encoding`. v4 writers
lift it into `sources[].embed` and clear it.

blob_encoding.description:
Legacy (v3) payload encoding tag (`step_import::STEP_BLOB_ENCODING`).
Absent with a present `blob` ⇒ that default encoding.

rotation_deg.description:
Placement: intrinsic X→Y→Z Euler angles in DEGREES, about the
imported model's origin.

scale.description: Extra uniform scale on top of the file's unit conversion (1.0 = none).

source_id.description: v4: the `sources[]` entry holding the STEP content.

translation_m.description: Placement: translation in METERS, applied after rotation.

Instance.description: One placed occurrence of a part.

external_key.description: Identity in an external tool (a KiCad footprint UUID, Phase 3b).

fixed.description:
Grounded: never moved by mates. The first non-suppressed instance is
implicitly grounded when none is marked.

parameter_overrides.description:
Design-parameter overrides for this instance (reserved; not applied
in Phase 3).

transform.description:
Explicit placement: authoritative for a grounded (`fixed`) instance
and for one no mate reaches; the starting point otherwise.

Locator.description: Where a source's content lives. Unknown `type`s are preserved verbatim and reported unresolvable.

remote.description: HTTPS clone URL, normalized without a trailing .git

oneOf.description: Unknown locator kind (opaque, preserved).

connectors.description:
`[a, b]`: `b`'s instance is placed against `a`'s when only one side
is placed; either direction works.

MateConnector.description:
A named frame on an instance's geometry. `geom_ref` (a face or an edge
of the part, in the part's own feature space) derives the frame from the
current geometry at evaluation time (`crate::connector`) — with
`frame.x_axis` as the secondary direction when set; without a `geom_ref`,
`frame` is the frame. Either way the connector's adjustments then apply
([`MateConnector::adjusted`]): `anchor` chooses the point on a rotational
face's axis, `flip_z` reverses z, `rotation_deg` turns about z, and
`offset_m` moves along the resulting axes. All four default to "as
derived", so a connector without them is exactly what it was before they
existed (additive, no reader-floor bump).

anchor.description:
Where on a rotational face's axis the derived frame sits (default:
the middle of the face's extent). See [`AxialAnchor`].

flip_z.description:
Reverse the frame's z axis (a 180° turn about x, so the basis stays
right-handed). The first adjustment applied.

instance_path.description:
Scope (v4 §2.8): the chain of instance ids from this assembly down to
the owning instance — `[instance]` for a part instance, `[instance,
member, …]` for a member of a sub-assembly instance (3d-2). The mate
solver moves the top-level instance; the member's relative placement
is composed into the frame at evaluation.

offset_m.description: Move along the frame's OWN axes after the turn, meters: `[x, y, z]`.

rotation_deg.description:
Turn about the frame's z, in degrees, after `flip_z`. What this moves
is the secondary (x) axis — a Fastened mate's in-plane alignment.

MateKind.description: How two mate connectors relate: Fastened (exact), Revolute, Slider, Cylindrical, Planar, Ball (numeric). Any other well-formed object with a string `type` (a mate kind from a newer build) is preserved verbatim and reported.

oneOf.description: Unknown mate kind (opaque, preserved; not solved).

Operation.description: A parametric modeling operation with its parameters. Any other well-formed object with a string `type` (an operation kind from a newer build) is preserved verbatim, re-emitted on save, and fails its rebuild loudly.

oneOf.description: Unknown operation kind (opaque, preserved; rebuild fails loudly).

OutputKey.description: Identifies which output of a feature to look in.

oneOf.description: The primary solid body output.
A secondary body (e.g., from boolean split).
A sketch profile (closed loop suitable for extrusion).
A datum plane/axis/point output.

PartRef.description:
Which part an instance is of: a Part tab of this document
(`source_id: None`) or of a linked `.waffle` source (v4 §2.3).

PlaneDefinition.description: How a construction plane is defined.

oneOf.description: Explicit origin + normal.
Parallel offset from another plane.

distance_expr.description:
Optional driving expression for `distance` (mm-space -> meters).
See `ExtrudeParams::depth_expr`.

oneOf.description:
Parallel offset from a planar face. The base face's plane (origin +
outward normal) is resolved from the *current* geometry each rebuild,
so the datum tracks the face as it moves. A non-planar base face
resolves to `ResolutionFailed` (loud). A negative distance flips the
offset to the back side of the face.

base.description: GeomRef of the planar face that defines the base plane.

distance_expr.description:
Optional driving expression for `distance` (mm-space -> meters).
See `ExtrudeParams::depth_expr`.

PreviewMesh.description: A lightweight mesh for 3D thumbnail previews.

ProjectedEntity.description:
A binding from a local sketch Point to the external geometry it projects.
The point remains an ordinary `SketchEntity::Point`; this side-table marks it
as externally driven so rebuild can re-derive its 2D position.

point_id.description: The local Point entity id this binding drives.

source.description: Where the point's position comes from.

ProjectedKind.description: How a projected point is derived from its resolved source entity.

oneOf.description: Source is a vertex; use its position directly.

Source is an edge; use the point at parameter `t` along it
(`t = 0` / `t = 1` are the endpoints; interior is exact for straight edges).

ProjectedSource.description: The external source a projected point reprojects from.

geom_ref.description: Reference to the source vertex/edge/face in an upstream feature output.

kind.description: How to derive a 3D point from the resolved source entity.

at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; optional (the engine has no clock of its own).

ProvenanceOrigin.description:
Who or what created a feature (`specs/waffle_v4_document_model.md` §2.7).
Absent from the table means `User`.

oneOf.description: Authored interactively.
Authored by a tool/model through the programmatic surface.
Created by importing a source (e.g. the STEP body of `sources[i]`).

Regenerated from a source by a named rule (e.g. a board outline from
a `.kicad_pcb`); read-only in the UI, replaced on re-sync.

RefScope.description:
Scope of a geometry reference into another tab's instance (v4 §2.8).

`source_id` absent ⇒ this document; `tab_id` absent ⇒ the current tab;
`instance_path` = the chain of assembly-instance ids from the referencing
assembly (`tab_id`) down to the part instance whose feature output the
anchor names. A Part feature edited in the context of an assembly
references the OTHER instances this way; the engine resolves such a
reference through its edit context (the `feature_engine::context`
module) and reports it loudly when the context is not open.

instance_path.description: Chain of assembly-instance ids down to the owning part instance.

source_id.description: The document the assembly lives in; absent ⇒ this document.

tab_id.description: The assembly tab the instance path starts from; absent ⇒ the current tab.

Region.description: A minimal closed face of the sketch, in sketch UV coordinates.

area.description:
Filled area (outer minus holes). The UI selects the smallest region whose
interior contains the click. Defaulted on deserialize so the extrude path
can send a geometry-only region (just `outer`/`holes`).

boundary_entity_ids.description:
Identity of this region independent of its coordinates: the sorted,
deduplicated ids of every sketch entity whose curve lies on the outer
or a hole boundary. A feature that stored this region re-resolves it
against the CURRENT sketch by this signature (see
`feature_engine::rebuild`), so editing the sketch — scaling it, moving
a corner — keeps the extrude on the same region instead of the frozen
polygon it was picked as. `None` for regions built without provenance
(unions, hand-built geometry).

holes.description: Hole boundaries (clockwise), each a closed loop. Empty for simple faces.

outer.description: Outer boundary, counter-clockwise. Curved boundaries are tessellated.

outer_edges.description:
Curve-aware outer boundary: the same loop as `outer`, but with runs that
lie on a source circle/arc recovered as [`RegionEdge::Arc`] (split into
minor arcs, vertices placed exactly on the circle). The extrude path
builds exact cylinder walls from these.

profile_entity_ids.description:
When `Some`, this region equals one whole-entity profile and has no holes:
these are that profile's `entity_ids`. The UI resolves them to a
`profile_index` and uses the existing analytical extrude path. When
`None`, the region is a genuine sub-region and must be extruded from its
explicit `outer`/`holes`.

RegionEdge.description:
One boundary edge of a region, in sketch UV coordinates. Mirrors the
kernel's `ProfileEdge` so a sub-region extrudes with true curved walls.

oneOf.description: Straight segment `a → b`.
Minor circular arc `a → b` (sweep `< π`) about `center` of `radius`.

ResolvePolicy.description: What to do when GeomRef resolution is ambiguous or fails.

oneOf.description: Fail the rebuild if the reference cannot be uniquely resolved.
Use the closest match and emit a warning.

Resolved.description: The commit actually loaded last time (git locators only).

angle_expr.description:
Optional driving expression for `angle` (evaluates to DEGREES).
See `ExtrudeParams::depth_expr`.

combine.description:
Explicit boolean-combine mode (see `ExtrudeParams::combine`). `None` ⇒
legacy file: derive from `cut`/`merge`.

cut.description: If true, subtract this revolve from the target body.

merge.description: If true (and cut=false), auto-union with the most recent body.

Role.description:
Semantic role assigned to topological entities by modeling operations.
Roles provide stable, meaningful names for geometry that survive topology changes.

oneOf.description: The face on the positive extrusion direction end.
The face on the negative extrusion direction end (original sketch plane face).
A lateral face created by sweeping a profile edge.
The face at the start of a revolution.
The face at the end of a revolution (if not full 360).
A face created by a fillet operation.
A face created by a chamfer operation.
An inner face created by a shell operation.
The original profile face (sketch plane) of an extrude/revolve.
An instance in a pattern operation.
A face from the first body in a boolean operation.
A face from the second body in a boolean operation.
Same depth as primary direction.
Independent blind depth in second direction.
Through all in second direction.
Up to a reference in second direction.

Selector.description: How to find a specific entity within a feature's output.

oneOf.description: Select by semantic role assigned during the operation.
Select by geometric signature matching.
Select by user-specified geometric query.
Select by 3D position (nearest entity within tolerance).

Sketch.description: A 2D sketch on a plane. Contains geometric entities and constraints.

plane.description: The plane this sketch lies on, referenced via GeomRef.

plane_normal.description: Normal of the sketch plane in 3D world space.

plane_origin.description: Origin of the sketch plane in 3D world space.

projected.description:
Projected-geometry bindings: sketch points that are driven by external
model geometry (a vertex/edge/face of an upstream feature). Each binding
maps a local Point id to the source it reprojects from on rebuild. Empty
for ordinary sketches. See `specs/projected_sketch_geometry.md`.

solve_status.description:
Current solve status (updated after each solve). Absent on the wire ⇒
[`SolveStatus::Unsolved`] (v4 §2.10): the engine's next rebuild solves
the sketch and replaces it, so a writer never has to run the solver.

solved_positions.description:
Solved positions for all points. Key is point entity ID.
Derived data — serialized when populated (for WASM→JS bridge), skipped when empty.

solved_profiles.description:
Closed profiles extracted from the solved geometry.
Derived data — serialized when populated (for WASM→JS bridge), skipped when empty.

oneOf.description:
Two points share a Y coordinate (a horizontal line passes through both).
Point-pair analogue of `Horizontal`, which acts on a single line's
endpoints. See specs/point_pair_horizontal_vertical.md.

Two points share an X coordinate (a vertical line passes through both).
Point-pair analogue of `Vertical`.

expression.description:
Optional driving expression over the design parameters (see
`feature_engine` parameters). When present, rebuild re-evaluates it
and writes the result into `value` (mm-space → meters). `value`
always holds the last evaluated result so downstream consumers and
old readers see a plain number.

reference.description:
Reference (driven) dimension: displays a measured value and must be
EXCLUDED from any driving-constraint set handed to the solver.

oneOf.description:
Perpendicular distance between a point and a line. Equivalent to a
`Distance` constraint over a (point, line) pair, but emitted directly by
the dimension tool's point–line and parallel-line measurements (for the
latter, `point` is one line's endpoint). See specs/dimension_tool.md.

Horizontal (x-axis) distance between two points: constrains `|Δx|`,
leaving the vertical offset free. Emitted by the dimension tool when the
placement leader selects a horizontal orientation. See specs/dimension_tool.md.

Vertical (y-axis) distance between two points: constrains `|Δy|`, leaving
the horizontal offset free. Point-pair analogue of `HDistance`.

expression.description: See `Distance::expression`. Evaluates to DEGREES (no unit scaling).

See `Distance::expression`. Drives the DIAMETER value (the radius-
style dimension editors wrap user input as `2*(…)` when storing).

oneOf.description:
Pin a point at an explicit target position (weight 1.0 — a real lock,
unlike `Dragged`'s 1/20 interaction hint which snapshots the point's
current position). Emitted by the bridge for origin/reference-point
snap pins. See specs/pinned_constraint.md.

SketchEntity.description: A geometric entity in a sketch.

oneOf.description: A parametric gear profile. Stored compactly; expanded to primitives on demand.

SolveStatus.description: Result of running the constraint solver.

oneOf.description:
Never solved: the sketch was written by a tool (an agent, a script)
that did not run the solver, or the field was absent on the wire. The
engine solves such a sketch on its next rebuild and replaces this
status; writers emit whatever the solve produced (v4 §2.10).
All constraints satisfied, zero degrees of freedom.
All constraints satisfied, but geometry can still move.

Constraints are contradictory. `conflicts` holds INDICES INTO THE
SOLVED SKETCH'S CONSTRAINT LIST (not residual row indices; multi-row
constraints own several rows), deduplicated, ordered by the owning
constraint's largest residual magnitude descending. The UI maps them
back through any filtering it applied before solving (e.g. reference
dimensions are excluded from the driving list).
Solver failed to converge.

content_hash.description: Algorithm-prefixed hash of the exact bytes last loaded (`crate::hash`).

id.description: Stable for the life of the document; relinking keeps it.

pack.description: Writer policy: emit `embed`. Absent ⇒ true for `Embedded`, else false.

SourceKind.description: What a source is. Unknown `type`s are preserved verbatim.

oneOf.description: Unknown source kind (opaque, preserved).

SplineSegment.description: A segment of a profile that should be built as a B-spline curve instead of a line.

control_points.description: Control points in sketch UV coordinates.

end_point_index.description: Index into the profile's entity_ids where the spline ends.

start_point_index.description: Index into the profile's entity_ids where the spline starts.

Tab.description:
A single tab in a document.

`id` is a document-level key matched by `active_tab` and, since v4, by
cross-tab references. New tabs get UUID strings; the type stays a
free-form `String` because legacy documents carry non-UUID ids (the
literal `"default"`) that must keep loading — the v3→v4 migration rewrites
those to fresh UUIDs.

TabKind.description: A tab's content: a `Part` (feature tree) or an `Assembly` (instances, mate connectors, mates). Any other well-formed object with a string `type` (a tab kind from a newer build: Drawing) is preserved verbatim and re-emitted on save.

oneOf.description: Unknown tab kind (opaque, preserved).

TieBreak.description: Tie-breaking strategy when multiple entities match a query.

oneOf.description: Pick the entity with the largest area.
Pick the entity nearest to the given point.
Pick the entity with the smallest index (arbitrary but deterministic).

TopoQuery.description: User-specified geometric query for selecting entities.

filters.description: Filters to narrow down candidate entities.

tie_break.description: How to break ties if multiple entities match.

TopoSignature.description:
Geometric signature of a topological entity.
Used for signature-based matching when role-based resolution fails.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box [min_x, min_y, min_z, max_x, max_y, max_z].

surface_type.description: Surface type (planar, cylindrical, conical, spherical, toroidal, nurbs).

Transform.description:
A rigid transform `p' = R p + t` with `R` as a unit quaternion
`[x, y, z, w]` (the JS/three.js order). Lengths in meters.

description: Owned mirror of the v5 envelope for schema derivation.

active_tab.description: Id of the tab open when saved; must name a tab.

min_reader_version.description: Oldest reader (by its FORMAT_VERSION) that can parse this file.

sources.description: External content the document depends on.
